top_signals.title: EU State aid rules enable social support and investments, new Commission guidance shows
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 27 Jul 2026 New guidance from the European Commission shows how State aid rules allow EU Member States to provide social support and social investment. This guidance assists Member States in designing State aid measures for social support and social investment, as set out in the Clean Industrial Deal.

top_signals.title: Commission greenlights Belgium's fifth payment request for €225 million under NextGenerationEU
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 27 Jul 2026 Today, the European Commission positively assessed Belgium's fifth payment request for €225 million under the Recovery and Resilience Facility (RRF), the centrepiece of NextGenerationEU.
